_comment: HIV Model V5 - Time-Scheduled ART/PrEP + Policy Scenario Forking

_v5_features.policy_year_forking: Run baseline to policy_start_year, then fork scenarios from frozen state
_v5_features.time_schedules: ART and PrEP availability/uptake controlled by year-based schedules
_v5_features.scenario_comparison: Multiple policy scenarios from identical baseline for HTA comparability

baseline_freeze_year.notes: Calendar year at which to freeze baseline state for scenario forking. All scenarios start from identical state at this year.

reuse_baseline.notes: If true, run baseline once and reuse for all scenarios. If false, rerun baseline for each scenario (slower but useful for debugging).

enabled.notes: Enable multi-scenario runs (V5 feature). If false, runs single scenario with base config.

definitions.name: status_quo
definitions.description: Baseline continuation - no policy changes post-freeze year

definitions.name: no_prep
definitions.description: PrEP unavailable from policy year onward

overrides.comment: This will set all PrEP uptake to 0 and remove existing PrEP users

definitions.name: oral_prep_scaleup
definitions.description: Oral PrEP scaled up from policy year

art_schedule.notes: Time-based ART availability and uptake rates. Before first year: ART unavailable (rate=0). Between years: use stepwise (carry-forward) or linear interpolation based on interpolation setting.

interpolation.notes: 'stepwise' (carry forward last value) or 'linear' (interpolate between years)

initiation.notes: Annual probability of ART initiation for diagnosed individuals not on treatment

discontinuation.notes: Annual probability of ART discontinuation (optional, defaults to 0 if not specified)

prep_schedules.notes: Time-based PrEP availability and uptake rates per intervention type. Before first year: PrEP unavailable (rate=0).

initiation.notes: Annual probability of PrEP initiation for eligible susceptible individuals
Lenacapavir not available until 2025 in this scenario
